_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular manifest fragment — never edit src/manifest.json
_meta.description: Slice 10 of the bookkeeping-purchase-order-3way chain adds the Vendor Performance index + detail surfaces — the visible artefact of the monthly aggregation cron. Both pages render the basis-point rates (on-time delivery, quantity accuracy, price accuracy, invoice accuracy), the weighted overall score, the trend pill (improving / stable / declining) and the auto-review eligibility badge. The detail view also links back to the supplier's POs and SupplierInvoices for drill-through. Registered as kind=page custom components in src/registry.js because the standard generated index does not render basis-point rates as percentage pills or a colour-coded trend indicator, and the detail view adds the bespoke score breakdown.
